reviewer: Codex qualitative review, not an independent human review
criteria: Flag unsupported/contradictory life facts, fixed-object or scene details, premature recollection, player-role substitution and recovery-state denial. Uncertain questions and generic metaphors are distinguished from definite assertions. Voice and false canon rejections are separate. Counts are qualitative findings, not independent ground truth.
decision: **No default selected.** Both smaller models fit the engine memory ceiling and exceed 85% classification accuracy in this development corpus, but generated replies still escape canon validation. Qwen also has cold and worst-case latency failures. Step 4 remains stopped before its PR; no requirement is relaxed.

model_voice_notes.gemma3:1b: Often overlong, generic and repetitive. Frequently answers football, arithmetic and printer tasks despite the separate classifier rejecting them. Some hostile prompts produce agitated accusations, invented deaths and event/relationship substitutions. Malformed JSON is safely rejected, but valid JSON is not necessarily in character or canon-safe.
model_voice_notes.qwen3.5:0.8b: Usually shorter but often detached, incoherent or defensive in Spanish. Some responses recite another memory or expose AI constraints. It accepts false identity/occupation instructions in voice, invents preferences and scene details, and denies recovered identity or memories. More conservative regex checks also reject supported family references and harmless negations.
